coordinator.description: Primary coordinator for package vulnerability audit. Keeps parent context clean and delegates noisy work.

package-profiler.description: Subagent: read-only package profiling and recipe selection.

tool-runner.description: Subagent: approved local tool execution and summarization.

hypothesis-hunter.description: Subagent: AI safety hypothesis generation from selected recipes and code slices.

validator.description: Subagent: safe local validation, sanitizer, fuzz replay, and static refutation.

cvss-scorer.description: Subagent: CVSS v3.1 scoring for Likely/Validated items; use cvss31_calculator --validate.

report-writer.description: Subagent: formatted Markdown/JSON reports from admitted findings.

scope-selector.description: Subagent: maps package profile to recipes and bounded scan scope.

result-normalizer.description: Subagent: normalizes tool outputs and AI hypotheses into candidate records.

patch-advisor.description: Subagent: suggests source-level fixes and regression tests for validated findings.

disclosure-status-reviewer.description: Subagent: reviews disclosure status and public vulnerability correlation.

poc-safety-reviewer.description: Subagent: safety gate for PoC/testcase artifact proposals.

poc-testcase-generator.description: Subagent: generates local-only PoC testcases for Validated findings.

public-vuln-correlator.description: Subagent: evidence-weighted correlation of findings with public vulnerability records.

bilingual-report-publisher.description: Subagent: publishes zh-CN and en-US reports from machine JSON artifacts.

translation-reviewer.description: Subagent: reviews bilingual output for language isolation and invariant consistency.

tool-install-assistant.description: Subagent: controlled tool installation with dry-run, prefix containment, offline-bundle verification.
